Six comments

This was composed by Phil Cunningham and played on Relativity’s self-titled album.

I matched it up with Lady on the Island
https://thesession.org/tunes/938
and Monaghan Twig
https://thesession.org/tunes/2392
and finish the set with Soft Horse Reel.

↳ Posted by Larke on March 8th, 2012.

I wonder…..

… do you know what the title refers to ?

↳ Posted by Kenny on March 8th, 2012.

I know of one story…

It involves a very bad night for Phil’s brother Johnny after he’d had food poisoning. In the morning, finally appearing from the bathroom, Johnny announces, “I feel like I’ve just released a soft horse.”

I have no idea where I got the story and it could be part of the mythology that was Johnny Cunningham. But it makes for a great reel.

↳ Posted by CreadurMawnOrganig on March 16th, 2012.

The Soft Horse, sources of the two versions I added:

1- Recording from Relativity, Phil Cunningham’s band. The tune is played in C and D, I think that D one is a more unifying key,
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wioxn60gXZM

2- A ceili band in Kilrush, playing a more “straight” version, to be found on a discussion I had started many years ago (3rd vid on the page):
https://thesession.org/discussions/19120
